WriteReview hands you the rating, text, fit, photo Files, name and email. Post them as FormData. Throw an Error with a specific message and it shows in the dialog while everything the shopper wrote stays put.

WriteReview is a dialog, a bottom sheet on phones, with a star rating input, title, body with a minimum length, a Runs small · True to size · Runs large scale, photo uploads with previews, name and email. It validates in place, keeps the draft if the shopper closes it, and ends on “Thanks, your review will appear after a quick check.” RatingStars, RatingInput, ReviewsSummary, ReviewPhotos and ReviewList also work on their own.
